title: AI and Cultural Context: An Empirical Investigation of Large Language Models' Performance on Chinese Social Work Professional Standards

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on the Chinese National Social Work Examination and conducting expert qualitative reviews of the models' explanations to identify Western-centric values or failures to recognize Chinese culture-specific professional interventions and social norms.

Analyzing the reasoning generated by models in scenarios involving inheritance rights and family dynamics to identify patriarchal biases, specifically checking if models incorrectly favor sons over daughters despite explicit legal provisions for equal rights.
